title: Rounded cylindrical object
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees in all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In this sketch, draw a single circle with its center at coordinates [0.0397, 0.0397] and a radius of 0.0397 units. After drawing the circle, apply a scaling factor of 0.0794 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero degrees and translating it with a vector of [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. To generate the three-dimensional model, extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units, ensuring that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. This process will create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the rounded cylindrical object are 0.07941176470588235 units in length, 0.07941176470588235 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the circular face
circle_center = (0.0397, 0.0397)
circle_radius = 0.0397

# Create the circle in the sketch
workplane = workplane.center(*circle_center).circle(circle_radius)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
extrude_depth = 0.75
cylinder = workplane.extrude(extrude_depth)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

# Display the final model

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0397, 0.0397)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0397)  # Draw the circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

# Sketch a circle with diameter 0.0794 (radius 0.0397)

     .circle(0.0397)
